description: Look up one US state's rules for youth programs, summarized by BackPR from official state sources and published copies of state law: childcare licensing, staff-to-child ratios, summer camp licensing, background checks, mandated reporting of child abuse and giving medication. Use it when someone asks what a state requires of a childcare center, camp or after-school program. Returns the section(s) asked for, the date BackPR checked them, the backpr.com section URL, source links and any facts BackPR couldn't confirm. General information, not legal advice.

state.description: US state name or 2-letter code, case-insensitive, such as "Texas" or "TX". "DC" and "District of Columbia" also work.

topic.description: Which rules to return: "licensing" (who must be licensed, exemptions), "ratios" (staff-to-child ratios and group sizes), "camps" (camp licensing), "background_checks", "mandated_reporting" (who must report child abuse, hotline), "medication" or "all" (default).
